Approximate flight routes of the missiles used so far in tonight's large-scale, combined missile attack on Ukraine. The following has been launched so far: ~10 Iskander-M ballistic missiles from Crimea and Bryansk Oblast ~3 Oniks-M supersonic cruise missiles from Kursk Oblast ~2 Zircon hypersonic cruise missiles from Rostov Oblast. At least two Iskander-Ms were shot down. Most/all of the other missiles impacted their targets. Later on, 50-70 Kh-101 cruise missiles from Tu-160M and Tu-95MS strategic bombers are expected to be launched, possibly alongside Kalibr cruise missiles.
